topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: From the following information, determine the cash flow from investing activities. Sale of building: carrying value Rs. 1,40,000 at a profit of Rs. 19,000.  Sale of long-term investment: carrying amount Rs. 1,70,000 at a loss of Rs. 8,500.  Purchase of car: Rs. 2,70,000 out of which Rs. 1,50,000 is outstanding Interest paid: Rs. 22,500.
e: Correct answer: Rs.2,00,500 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The following are the examples of personal accounts, except:-
e: Correct answer: Cash (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following is the main purpose to prepare a Revenue Account for general insurance business? Choose the most appropriate option.
o: To show a summary of income and expenditure relating to the insurance business during an accounting period
To show the true and fair view of the financial co
To compare the financial condition of the company
To explain the cash flow of the company during the
To show the condition of the assets and investment
e: Correct answer: To show a summary of income and expenditure relating to the insurance business during an accounting period (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The health of a director is not recorded in the books of accounts. This is application of which accounting concept?
e: Correct answer: Money measurement concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: An accounting record into which the essential facts and figures in connection with all transactions are initially recorded is called the:-
e: Correct answer: Account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A company is said to be the subsidiary of another company if _____________.
o: More than 50% of the share capital of the company is held by the other company
Less than 50% of the share capital of the company
The other company appoints one director on the boa
More than 50% of the debt of the company is held b
More than 50% of the preference share capital of t
e: Correct answer: More than 50% of the share capital of the company is held by the other company (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which one of the following types of audit would not normally be part of the financial statement audit?
o: A profit and loss account audit.
e: Correct answer: An internal control audit. (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The books of accounts of Greenwich General Insurance Co Ltd shows the following closing balances as on 31<SUP>st</SUP> March 2016 in respect of its Fire Dept.: Premium from Direct Business - Rs. 98,000 Premium on Reinsurance Accepted - Rs. 34,000 Net Premium for 2010-11 - Rs. 1,05,000 Claim Paid Direct - Rs. 70,000 Claims on Reinsurance Accepted - Rs. 29,000 Commission Paid Direct - Rs. 10,000 Commission on Reinsurance Accepted - Rs. 6,000. From the information given above calculate the operating profit/loss.
e: Correct answer: Rs. 3,500 - Profit (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which one of the following statements is not true about the International Practices in respect of recognition of premium?
o: Written premiums should comprise the total premium
If written premiums are subject to a reduction, an
Where written premiums are subject to a retrospect
The estimate of pipeline premiums shall relate only to those contracts of insurance where the period of cover has commenced after the balance sheet date.
Written premiums sometimes may include an estimate
e: Correct answer: The estimate of pipeline premiums shall relate only to those contracts of insurance where the period of cover has commenced after the balance sheet date. (from the IC46 question bank).

Actual Tax Liability for 2007-08 is 1,40,000/-
Provisions for Taxation for 2007-08 is 1,30,000 and for 2008-09 is to be made for 1,50,000.

What is the amount of tax payable for the year 2007-08 after adjusting the advance tax?

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
A company has invested in approved investments but they are downgraded below the minimum rating prescribed. Such investments shall be classified under which of the following head?

I. Approved investments
II. Other Investments
III. Downgraded investments
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Ind AS 104 applies to:

I. Accounting for an insurance contract issued by an entity
II. Accounting for financial assets held by an insurance company
III. Accounting for financial liabilities issued by an insurance company
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following is a characteristic of generally accepted accounting principles?
o: Common set of standards and principles
Practices that become accepted for at least a year
Acceptance requires an affirmative vote of Certifi
Acceptance requires an affirmative vote of Charter
Standards and principles are based federal statute
e: Correct answer: Common set of standards and principles (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following is a capital expenditure?
o: Wages paid to claims department staff
e: Correct answer: Purchase of office premises (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per AS 2, inventory valued under the standard cost methods take into account:-

I. Normal level of production
II. Actual level of production
III. Abnormal level of production
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which among the following are the objectives of accounting?

I. Assessment and evaluation of financial health of entity
II. Communication of information to stakeholders
III. Preparing management information reports
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
As per the Indian GAAP, a complete set of financial statements of a company shall include which of the following?

I. Balance Sheet as at the end of financial year
II. Profit & loss Account
III. Cash Flow Statement for the financial year
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Shaurya prepares financial statements for 31 December 2008. Shaurya purchased machinery on 1 January 2004 for Rs.70,000. He  incurred installation expenses of Rs.15,000 for the machinery. The expected useful life of the machinery was 8 years. It charges depreciation on a straight line basis. The estimated realisable value after 8 years is expected to be Rs.5,000. What is the depreciation charge for 2008?
e: Correct answer: Rs.10,000 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Identify the main purpose of preparing Profit & Loss A/c in a general insurance business.

I. To show a summary of income and expenditure
II. To determine the net profit or loss
III. To show the assets and liabilities
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
A single entry accounting system does not give consideration to:

I. Nominal accounts
II. Real accounts except cash
III. Personal accounts
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements are true?

I. Deferred tax assets are the amount of income taxes recoverable in future periods in respect of taxable temporary differences
II. Deferred tax are not a part of the tax expense
III. Deferred taxes are disclosed as contingent liabilities and contingent assets
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: In accordance with the IRDAI circular prescribing maximum agency and brokerage commission, the maximum agency commission permissible for Marine hull business is:-
e: Correct answer: 10% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The method of inventory valuation should be reported in the financial statements under what qualitative characteristic of accounting information?
e: Correct answer: Consistency (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following documents, data and particulars are a part of the annual report of a general insurance company?

I. Financial Results
II. Segment Reporting Schedule
III. Balance Sheet Abstract
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following journal entries records a bonus issue?
o: Debit Cash at bank and Credit Share Capital
Debit Share Capital and credit Share premium
Debit Share premium  and credit Share Capital
Debit Share Capital and Credit Cash at bank
Debit Share Capital and Credit Profit and Loss Acc
e: Correct answer: Debit Share premium  and credit Share Capital (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Debit balance as per Cash Book of Adiko Enterprise as on 31 March 2015 is Rs. 1,500. Cheques deposited but not cleared amounted to Rs. 100 and cheques issued but not presented amounted to Rs.150. The bank allowed interest amounting Rs. 50 and collected dividend Rs. 50 on behalf of Adiko Enterprises. Balance as per pass book should be:
e: Correct answer: Rs.1,650 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Premium was collected by an Insurance Company. In this case the premium collected account shall be __________ and the cash account shall be ___________.
e: Correct answer: Credited, debited (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: This concept states that the revenue from any business transaction should be included in the accounting records only when it is realised. Identify the concept.
e: Correct answer: Realisation concept (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Sheela bought a machine for Rs.50,000, which she expects to have a useful life of four years and a scrap value of Rs.4,000 at the end of that time. If depreciation is to be provided on the straight-line basis, the net book value after two years will be:-
e: Correct answer: Rs. 27,000 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The provisions on statutory audit of a branch is provided under which section of the Companies Act, 2013?
e: Correct answer: Sec. 143 of the Companies Act, 2013 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: A cheque of Rs. 2,500 received from a debtor was recorded in the cash book, but omitted to be banked. When balance as per cash book is starting point:
o: Rs.2,500 is to be added to bank reconciliation
Rs.2,500 is to be subtracted to bank reconciliatio
Cash book needs to be rectified
Pass book needs to be rectified
e: Correct answer: Rs.2,500 is to be subtracted to bank reconciliatio (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following organisations recommend the "Indian Accounting Standards" to Central Government?
o: ICAI (Institute of Chartered Accountants of India)
Institute of Costs and Works Accountants of India
Institute of Companies Secretaries of India (ICSI)
e: Correct answer: ICAI (Institute of Chartered Accountants of India) (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
AS 5 should be applied in presenting profit or loss from:

I. Ordinary activities
II. Extraordinary items
III. Prior period items
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: What suggestion would you propose when it comes to determining the qualities of a reinsurer?
o: Reinsurer must be known for his reasonableness
Reinsurer must be known for his financial soundness, reasonableness and promptness
e: Correct answer: Reinsurer must be known for his financial soundness, reasonableness and promptness (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per of IRDAI (Preparation of Financial Statements and Auditor's Report of Insurance Companies) Regulations, 2002 which Schedule provides for the format of the financial statements of General Insurance Companies?
e: Correct answer: Schedule B (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following is correct journal entry for reinsurance premium accepted for current year?
o: Dr. Cedant A/c      Cr. Premium A/c
Dr. Cedant A/c      Cr. Bank A/c
Dr. Premium A/c      Cr. Cedant A/c
Dr. Reinsurer A/c      Cr. Premium A/c
Dr. Premium A/c      Cr. Reinsurer A/c
e: Correct answer: Dr. Cedant A/c      Cr. Premium A/c (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: With regards to preparation of financial statements of a general insurance company, items of expenses and income in excess of _______ of the total premiums (less reinsurance) or Rs.5,00,000 whichever is higher, shall be shown as a separate line item.
e: Correct answer: 1% (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Details of the underwriting results for the reporting period would be presented in the ___________.
e: Correct answer: Revenue Account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India has been incessantly trying to reduce the difference in the adoption of accounting policies by different entities by taking which of the following steps?

I. Issuance of 'Guidance Notes'
II. Issuance of 'Accounting Standards'
III. Imposing penalties
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Device a term to define the value created due to taxes paid or carried forward but not yet recognized in the Profit and Loss Account.
e: Correct answer: Deferred Tax Asset (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following items shall be included in the current Assets section of a Company's Balance Sheet?
o: Loans and advances to  related parties
e: Correct answer: Inventories (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Inventories are assets which are:

I. Held for sale in the ordinary course of business
II. Held in the form of materials or supplies to be consumed in the production process or in the rendering of services.
III. In the process of production for such sale
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: An unqualified audit report provides assurance to users of the financial statements that:-
o: The directors have run the company efficiently and
The internal auditors have operated efficiently an
The internal controls operated within the company
That the financial statements of the company depic
The accounts and financial statements of an entity are prepared in accordance with the facts, correct principles and applicable / accepted regulations and standards, and are said to be true and fair
e: Correct answer: The accounts and financial statements of an entity are prepared in accordance with the facts, correct principles and applicable / accepted regulations and standards, and are said to be true and fair (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: The Auditing Assurance Standards applicable in India are issued by which of the following?
o: Institute of Company Secretaries of India
American Institute of Certified Public Accountants
Institute of the Chartered Accountants of India
e: Correct answer: Institute of the Chartered Accountants of India (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which of the following items may appear as current liabilities in a company's balance sheet?
e: Correct answer: Proposed Dividend (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: If a transaction is completely omitted from the books of accounts, will it affect the agreement of a trial balance?
e: Correct answer: No (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: If there is a loss of Rs. 1,00,000 under a 40 percent quota share reinsurance treaty, the cedant will bear __________.
e: Correct answer: Rs.60,000 (from the IC46 question bank).
